scientific_limitations: Eosinophilic oesophagitis is type-2 immune-mediated, not established as classical autoimmunity; ACG 2025 guideline DOI 10.14309/ajg.0000000000003194.
Inflammatory bowel disease is heterogeneous chronic immune-mediated inflammation, not interchangeable with an autoantibody-defined autoimmune disorder.
Coeliac disease and autoimmune atrophic gastritis have better-characterised autoimmune components; achalasia's immune mechanisms are etiologically heterogeneous.
Drawn barrier, leukocyte interactions and histology-like patterns are conceptual illustrations, not data or a diagnosis.
Intestinal permeability, microbiome signatures and the gut-brain axis are not portrayed as universal confirmed causes of disease.
